verdict.rationale: Docs consistently claim microVM-based isolation with Linux microVMs described as the mechanism for running untrusted/agent-generated code without exposing production systems, plus per-agent Linux user isolation. However, there is no detailed technical documentation of the isolation architecture (e.g., hypervisor used, security boundary specifics, escape mitigations) and no independent/hands-on validation of the isolation claims. Missing for 10: detailed architecture docs on the microVM implementation/hypervisor, independent security audits or hands-on penetration tests, and third-party corroboration of the isolation boundary's robustness.
